def ghz_protocol(state):
    # Determine the dimension of the input state
    D = state.shape[0]  # Dimension of the 2n-qubit system
    d = int(np.sqrt(D))  # Dimension of each n-qubit system (2^n)
    
    # Create the parity projector P = |00...0><00...0| + |11...1><11...1|
    # This is a diagonal matrix with 1 at positions 0 and d-1, and 0 elsewhere
    P = np.zeros((d, d), dtype=float)
    P[0, 0] = 1.0
    P[d-1, d-1] = 1.0
    
    # The combined parity projector on the 2n-qubit system is P1 ⊗ P2
    # P1 = P (acts on first n qubits)
    # P2 = P (acts on last n qubits)
    # P_combined = P ⊗ P (dimension D x D)
    P_combined = np.kron(P, P)
    
    # Apply the parity measurement: P_combined @ state @ P_combined^T
    # Since P_combined is real and symmetric, P_combined^T = P_combined
    P_state_P = P_combined @ state @ P_combined
    
    # Calculate the trace to normalize
    trace = np.trace(P_state_P)
    
    # If trace is 0 (no even parity), return zero matrix
    if trace < 1e-15:
        return np.zeros((4, 4), dtype=float)
    
    # Normalize the post-measurement state
    rho_prime = P_state_P / trace

    post_selected = V @ rho_prime @ V.T
